title: 第3章 宋南烛 我一定要补偿你第4章 四国百家
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
昨晚小花跟他讲了很久，也不知道什么时候睡着的。
大清早沈无名就被饿醒了，毕竟昨天饿了一整天，晚上又经历大变，颗米未进。
正打算弄点吃的，房门外就传来脚步声，有人敲了敲门，随即推门而入。
赫然就是自己的妻子楚幼仪，身后的小跟班就是太平公主宋南烛。
楚幼仪气质端庄，一身淡雅白裙，却能看出是一个斯文端庄的古典美女。
至于宋南烛，妖女，魔女，悍女……虽然长得很美，但的确很难给人美女的感觉。
“夫君，你今天有什么事吗？”
楚幼仪端着一个食盘，上面放了两碟小菜，一碗粥，还有三个拳头大小的白面馒头。
然后转头看向沈无名，放柔了声调问道。
沈无名摇了摇头，“昨天被打了之后，脑袋有点疼，有些东西忘了。”
“我只知道自己叫沈无名，我……我现在什么都不记得了，不知道该干啥！”
从昨天晚上几人动手的情况来看，这似乎是一个有些超能力的世界。
这会儿本来就是顶了人家的名头，害怕出漏洞，干脆就说自己失忆了。
“啊？”楚幼仪面色微怔，随即有些担忧，“到底什么情况，严不严重？”
“我不知道。”沈无名苦笑一声，摇了摇头。
按照小花所说，所有人都认定了他就是原本的沈无名，现在只能少做少错。
但凡乱说一点东西出来，恐怕都会惹出幺蛾子。
“我去叫大夫来帮你看看。”宋南烛抿了抿嘴，满脸惭愧。
说完就转身朝着门外走去。
她去叫大夫，沈无名来到餐桌前，还是先垫垫肚子再说。

小菜和馒头都很普通，但味道却极佳好，一看就知道侯府的厨子不错。
而且也不知道是不是错觉，吃完东西之后，还感觉有一股热流蔓延全身。
似乎来了精神……估计是昨天饿太狠了吧？
……
沈无名坐在桌边，老大夫手中涌出一团散发莹莹光芒的医家法力，送入他的体内。
感受到那股热气在全身上下不断游走，沈无名眼中也露出惊讶。
这就是此方世界超自然的力量吗？
与此同时。
【你观摩医家修士切脉，感受医家法力在体内的行走路径，领悟‘秦越人切脉法’】
沈无名心头微震。
金手指终于发挥用处了。
就在此时，他脑中若有所悟，望着老者的手怔怔出神……
他似乎能看懂。
“大夫，他还有救吗？”
宋南烛捏着衣角，脸色有些发白，看到老大夫将把脉的手抽开，连忙问道。
“这可能是……”
content_en:
Xiaohua talked to him for a long time last night, but she didn't know when she fell asleep.
Shen Wuming was woken up by hunger early in the morning. After all, he had been hungry all day yesterday and had experienced a big change at night, so he had not eaten a single grain of rice.
Just as he was about to get something to eat, there were footsteps outside the door. Someone knocked on the door and then pushed the door open.
Surprisingly, it was his wife Chu Youyi, and the little attendant behind him was Princess Taiping Song Nanzhu.
Chu Youyi has a dignified temperament. She is wearing an elegant white dress, but she can be seen as a elegant and dignified classical beauty.
As for Song Nanzhu, she is a witch, a witch, and a fierce woman... Although she is very beautiful, it is indeed difficult to give people the impression of a beauty.
"Husband, what do you want to do today?"
Chu Youyi was carrying a food plate with two plates of side dishes, a bowl of porridge, and three fist-sized white flour steamed buns on it.
Then he turned to look at Shen Wuming and asked in a soft tone.
Shen Wuming shook his head, "After being beaten yesterday, my head hurts a little and I forgot some things."
"I only know that my name is Shen Wuming. I...I don't remember anything now. I don't know what to do!"
Judging from the actions of several people last night, this seems to be a world with some superpowers.
At this time, I was taking advantage of others' names, and fearing that there would be some loopholes, I simply said that I had lost my memory.
"Ah?" Chu Youyi looked slightly startled, and then became worried, "What is the situation? Is it serious?"
"I don't know." Shen Wuming smiled bitterly and shook his head.
According to Xiaohua, everyone has recognized that he is the original Shen Wuming, and now they can only do less and make fewer mistakes.
If you say anything nonsense, I'm afraid it will cause trouble.
"I'll ask the doctor to take a look at you." Song Nanzhu pursed his lips, his face full of shame.
After saying that, he turned around and walked towards the door.
She went to call the doctor. When Shen Wuming came to the dining table, he had better rest his stomach first.
The side dishes and steamed buns are very ordinary, but they taste very good. You can tell at a glance that the cooks in Hou Mansion are good.
And I don’t know if it was an illusion, but after eating, I felt a heat spreading throughout my body.
She seemed to be in high spirits... I guess she was too hungry yesterday, right?
…
Shen Wuming sat at the table, and a ball of medical mana emitting gleaming light came out of the old doctor's hand and was sent into his body.
Feeling the heat flowing throughout his body, Shen Wuming's eyes also showed surprise.
Is this the supernatural power of this world?
at the same time.
[You observe the medical monks' pulse-taking, feel the path of the medical magic power in the body, and understand the 'Qinyue people's pulse-taking method']
Shen Wuming's heart was slightly shaken.
The golden finger finally came into play.
At this moment, something came to his mind, and he looked at the old man's hand in a daze...
He seemed to understand.
"Doctor, can he still be saved?"
Song Nanzhu pinched the corner of his clothes and turned a little pale. When he saw the old doctor taking away his hand to check the pulse, he asked quickly.
"This could be..."
